answer: The fruit either comes down whole or it bruises on the fall, and the keeper lays straw under every tree before the picking starts. Proof of orchard ladder via orchard keepers is a ladder of that kind: a ladder the orchard keepers keep only after the keeper picks a bushel he actually gathered. The delta feeds the orchard below the hill, and the trees bear or they stand barren. 29 invented ladders take 29 keepers and 29 harvests the keeper never picked; each needs a copper pail that never held a single apple, and a meadow where the ungathered fruit rots.
